shared_elements: figure rendered on a tall upright slab with rounded/decorated top
offerings or objects held or presented
justification: Both depict a tall upright monument bearing human figures with tall headdresses accompanied by dense fields of non-alphabetic script signs, a generic correspondence found in many commemorative traditions. Beyond that they differ entirely: A shows slender, flat, profile figures in a small upper scene with an offering table and rayed disc above, over many neat horizontal registers of small glyphs, while B shows a single massive frontal figure in high relief whose deeply carved, densely interlocking ornament, mask elements and hanging regalia fill the whole surface with no register system.
